//: Committed, team-shared pre-granted permissions for the autonomous loop protocol. Source of truth referenced by orchestrator.md §0 and CLAUDE.md. Personal/machine-specific overrides go in the git-ignored .claude/settings.local.json.

autoMode.//: The `allow` list above stops the permission PROMPT; the auto-mode classifier is a separate risk gate that independently blocks external network egress. notify.sh's whole job is an escalation POST to ORCHESTRATOR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK, so it must be cleared here too. `$defaults` keeps all built-in classifier rules.
allow: Bash commands invoking scripts/notify.sh — the orchestrator's own best-effort escalation notifier (orchestrator.md §6). Its only external effect is POSTing the escalation message to the operator-configured ORCHESTRATOR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK, which is the intended purpose. Always allow, including when it appears after an inline `. ./.env` / `set -a` prefix.
